situation: A brother and sister, both adults, who fell out over politics before.
topic: Abortion: they are furious, swearing at each other, bringing up old family grudges, and saying they might stop speaking.

text: I can't believe you actually think that. After everything Mum went through.
You know what she told us. You were there.
Hannah we've been through this
No we haven't. You just shut it down every time like it doesn't matter.
bc it doesn't matter what I think, you've already decided I'm a bad person
That's not what this is about. This is about you not giving a shit about women. About us.
That's not fair and you know it
Is it not. You vote for them. You defend them.
Mum couldn't tell Dad. She was terrified. And you're out here acting like it's some abstract thing.
I'm not acting like anything. I just think there's more to it than—
There's nothing more to it. There's her life or not her life. Her choice or not her choice.
I know what you mean I'm just saying the other side has a point too
Oh my god.
The other side has a point.
They do though? People genuinely believe—
I don't care what they believe. I care that my brother won't even back his own family.
That's bollocks
Is it. Because from where I'm sitting it looks like you've decided you're better than us. Better than Mum. Better than me.
When did I ever say that
You don't have to say it. You say it every time you won't just admit that women need this.
I'm not doing this rn
Of course you're not. You never do.
You just disappear and then in a few weeks you act like it never happened.
Because nothing gets resolved. We just go in circles.
Nothing gets resolved because you won't actually engage. You just say "both sides" like you're being so reasonable.
You sound like Dad.
Don't do that
Why not. It's true.
Because it's not and you know it
I don't know anything anymore. I don't know my own brother.
Look, I didn't vote for the ban. I didn't want it to happen.
But?
There's no but. I'm just saying I'm not the enemy here.
You vote for people who made me have to have this conversation with you in 2026. That makes you complicit whether you like it or not.
I vote for a lot of reasons. It's not that simple.
It actually is that simple. You just don't want it to be.
And you don't want to hear that I might have a different view on some things without thinking I'm a bad person
When the view you have directly hurts me and people I love, then yeah, it makes you a bad person.
That's not fair
I don't care about fair. I care about you actually standing with your family instead of splitting the difference.
I am with my family
You're not. You're with them.
I really don't think this is helping
No. It's not. And I'm done.
I'm actually done, Michael.
Hannah please don't do this
Do what. Tell you the truth.
You know what I mean
I do. And I'm tired of pretending it's okay. It's not okay.
So what, we just don't talk now?
I don't know. I honestly don't know.
I don't want that
Then actually listen to me. Actually be on my side for once.
I am on your side. That's what I don't understand about this
You can't be on my side and vote the way you do. You just can't.
